Ultimate Ears boom 3 is a super-portable wireless speaker built for adventure. It rocks immersive 360° sound with deep bass, all carefully balanced so you can hear every note. But boom 3 also hangs tough. It’s seriously waterproof, dustproof, and drop proof which means you can bring Vibes anywhere. From the desert festival to the pool party and everywhere in between. Plus boom 3 features the all-new magic button so you can play, pause and skip songs directly on the Bluetooth speaker. And it is wrapped in a stunning, high-performance fabric that shimmers. The ultimate go-anywhere speaker just got more ultimate.

The Great Cost-effective Bluetooth Speaker  Features:  IPX7 Waterproof Shower Speaker -With fully enclosed and IPX7 waterproof design, to prevent the external splashing and dust. It is absolutely okay to take this shower speaker to the bathroom, swimming pool, beach, and outdoor use safely.  Dual Pairing Function Enjoy your music with 360-degree stereo sound through 5W high-performance drivers and enhanced bass. Dual pairing technology provides separate left and right channels, allows you to truly enjoy the surround sound of the cinema, it's an auditory experience that's truly unparalleled.  Easy to Pair Quick to Use Voice prompts makes pairing with your devices such as phone, iPad, tablets, laptops, MAC, MP3 easier than ever. Bluetooth 5.0 version brings you faster and stabler signal transmission in 2X speed than 4.2 version.  Make Hands-free Calling at Ease Waterproof speaker with built-in microphone for hands-free Call, it's convenient to pick up a call by this mini speaker in your bathroom, at home or office, everywhere during it is connected to your smartphone.  Large-capacity Battery Built-in high-capacity lithium battery, battery life up to 6 hours, standby up to 360 hours. You'll be able to enjoy your favorite songs whenever (and wherever) you please.  Super Portable This portable bluetooth speaker is a compact lightweight speaker that is easy to carry. Speaker is equipped with Lanyard, you can use to hang the mini speaker on the backpack. Whether you spend your leisure time at the beach, or Hiking, Camping, Cycling, Kayaking, this speaker is the consummate travel companion for all your outdoor excursions.
